key_findings: Compound 194 blocks CRMP2 SUMOylation, uncouples CRMP2/Nav1.7, reduces Nav1.7 membrane diffusion and currents and TG neuron excitability.
Intranasal 194 reduced mechanical allodynia and nociception in male and female rats with ION-CCI.
